correctness.rationale: For each claimed torus weight the homogeneous complexified Laplacian cancels adjacent radial coefficients; Q(0)=1 ensures that its rational polynomial is nonzero. The character weights correspond bijectively to the side-(ℓ+1) square in (m+n,m−n) coordinates and span by dimension. At nonnodal s the evaluation columns are nonzero multiples of Fourier columns, proving the rank and inversion statements; e^(−1) avoids every rational-polynomial zero. Put L=ℓ+1. For even ℓ the stated primitive winding gives consecutive nonoverlapping frequency blocks Li−j, hence all L² residues. For odd ℓ at critical size L², inversion on the nonzero weights has no fixed points, so cannot be in equivariant bijection with the residues 0 and L²/2 fixed by inversion there. At L²+1 the given (1,L) winding gives a collision equation (L+1)A−(L−1)B=r(L²+1) with r=0,±1. For r=0 coprimality forces A=B=0; for r=1 and L≥4 the only possible A are 1 and 2−L and yield B=−L and −2L−1, outside the allowed square. Negating proves r=−1 impossible; for L=2 the four residues are ±1,±2 modulo five. The unique unused residue of any optimal injective odd rule is zero by inversion symmetry. Independently built harmonic-projector evaluation matrices over finite fields have full rank for ℓ=1–7, and all critical-count residue windings were exhausted for odd ℓ=1,3,5. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproductions/frozen_math_checks.py 1; output /workspace/reproductions/record-1.txt. originality.rationale: Credit the harmonic basis and exceptional-radius treatment to the rectangular Hopf-grid predecessor, and the reconstruction criterion and DFT formula to general rank-one lattice theory. The supported distinction is the exact all-winding sample minimum in the one-trajectory architecture, including the parity obstruction and explicit attaining primitive windings. Neither a product-grid minimum, a fixed-winding rank theorem, nor a criterion testing a supplied rank-one lattice gives that exact optimum. The degree-one five-site (1,2) example is prior coverage of that instance. This is a bounded judgment about the all-degree theorem, not a priority claim for all of its ingredients.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact lattice design theorem for equivalent parity-restricted frequency sets could cover the optimum; the inspected reconstructibility criterion does not do so.
